primary_sources.title: Task 005 Retrieval Integration - Apple 2024 10-K Search Results
primary_sources.synthesis: Retrieval results for 3 ESG queries against Apple 2024 10-K chunks. Contains 9 results total with relevance scores (0.0-0.5), text snippets, and full provenance metadata. Queries: 'climate risk', 'environmental regulations', 'carbon emissions'.

primary_sources.title: RubricV3Scorer Implementation
primary_sources.synthesis: Deterministic ESG scoring engine using keyword-based maturity rubric (v3.0). Scores findings across multiple dimensions (Climate, Governance, etc.) using stage characteristics and keywords. Returns maturity level (0-5), confidence, and dimension breakdown.

primary_sources.title: Rubric Data Models
primary_sources.synthesis: Pydantic models defining rubric structure: MaturityRubric, Theme, Stage, Characteristic. Supports loading from JSON/YAML and provides structured access to scoring criteria.
